# Part 4: T cells

## 4.1 Parameters

```{r tcell-params}
tcell_params <- list(
  celltype_var   = "celltypes",
  donor_var      = "patient_ID",
  diagnosis_var  = "diagnosis",
  lineage_levels = c("CD4+T-Cells", "CD8+T-Cells"),
  resolutions    = c(0.6, 1.6, 2.4, 2.6),
  base_res       = c(CSF = 2.4, PBMC = 1.6),
  seed           = c(CSF = 1, PBMC = 1)
)
```


```{r load, eval=!tcells_cached}
t_cells <- lapply(qread(file.path(path$objects, "03R_xALD_filtered_integrated.qs")), function(o) {
  o <- subset(o, cells = colnames(o)[o@meta.data[[tcell_params$celltype_var]] %in% tcell_params$lineage_levels])
  o$lineage <- droplevels(factor(as.character(o@meta.data[[tcell_params$celltype_var]]),
                                 levels = tcell_params$lineage_levels))
  o
})
invisible(gc())
sapply(t_cells, ncol)
```

## 4.4 Embedding and clustering

```{r cluster-run, eval=!tcells_cached}
set.seed(42)
t_cells <- imap(t_cells, function(so, ti)
  lineage_cluster(lineage_embed(so), tcell_params$resolutions, tcell_params$base_res[[ti]], tcell_params$seed[[ti]]))

purrr::imap_dfr(t_cells, function(o, n) tibble(
  compartment = n, resolution = tcell_params$resolutions,
  n_clusters = sapply(tcell_params$resolutions, function(r) dplyr::n_distinct(o[[lineage_res_col(r)]][, 1])),
  knn_purity = sapply(tcell_params$resolutions, function(r) round(knn_purity(o, lineage_res_col(r)), 4))))
lapply(t_cells, function(so) table(so$seurat_clusters))
qsave(t_cells, tcells_clustered_output)
```

```{r seed-stability, eval=!tcells_cached}
purrr::imap_dfr(t_cells, function(so, ti)
  lineage_seed_stability(so, tcell_params$base_res[[ti]], tcell_params$seed[[ti]]) %>% mutate(tissue = ti, .before = 1))
```

```{r cluster-umaps, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, eval=!tcells_cached}
purrr::imap(t_cells, function(so, cmp)
```


### 4.6.1 Label order

```{r label-order}
lineage_of <- function(x)
  ifelse(grepl("^CD4|^Treg|^Th17", x), "CD4", ifelse(grepl("^CD8", x), "CD8", "other"))
state_rank <- function(x) {
  ord <- c("naive", "T-Helper", "Effector", "Memory", "TEMRA", "Treg", "Th17")
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    m <- which(vapply(paste0("\\b", ord, "\\b"), grepl, logical(1), x = s, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (length(m)) m[1] else length(ord) + 1L
  }, integer(1))
}
info <- data.frame(ct = sort(unique(c(as.character(csf$celltype), as.character(pbmc$celltype)))),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
info$grp <- factor(lineage_of(info$ct), levels = c("CD4", "CD8", "other"))
info <- info[order(info$grp, state_rank(info$ct), info$ct), ]
all_labels_csf <- all_labels_pbmc <- info$ct
info
```

### 4.7.2 Lineage heatmaps and dot plots

```{r dotplot, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 15}
obj      <- t_cells_filtered$CSF
group_by <- "celltype"
assay    <- "RNA"
cap      <- 2
scale_within_panel <- TRUE

modules_cd4 <- list(
  "Lineage"       = c("CD4", "CD40LG"),
  "Naive / Tcm"   = c("CCR7", "TCF7", "SELL", "LEF1"),
  "Memory"        = c("S100A4", "ANXA1", "AQP3"),
  "Residency"     = c("CD69", "CXCR6", "ITGAE", "RGS1"),
  "Th1 / effector"= c("IFNG-AS1", "IFNG", "GZMK", "CCL5", "GZMA"),
  "Treg"          = c("FOXP3", "IL2RA", "IKZF2", "CTLA4", "TIGIT", "RTKN2"))

modules_cd8 <- list(
  "Lineage"       = c("CD8A", "CD8B"),
  "Naive / Tcm"   = c("CCR7", "TCF7", "LEF1", "NELL2", "MAL"),
  "Memory"        = c("S100A4", "IL7R"),
  "Residency"     = c("CD69", "CXCR6", "ITGAE", "ZNF683"),
  "Cytotoxic"     = c("CCL5", "NKG7", "GZMA"),
  "Eff. GZMK+"    = c("GZMK", "CMC1", "EOMES"),
  "Eff. late"     = c("CX3CR1", "FGFBP2", "KLRG1"),
  "MAIT"          = c("SLC4A10", "TRAV1-2", "KLRB1", "RORC"),
  "\u03b3\u03b4"  = c("TRDC", "TRGC1", "TRDV2")
)

pops     <- levels(factor(obj@meta.data[[group_by]]))
cd8_pops <- grep("CD8|MAIT|\u03b3\u03b4|gdT|GDT", pops, value = TRUE)
cd4_pops <- setdiff(pops, cd8_pops)

message("CD8 panel: ", paste(cd8_pops, collapse = " | "))
message("CD4 panel: ", paste(cd4_pops, collapse = " | "))

panel_df <- function(pops_use, modules) {

  map <- data.frame(
    gene   = unlist(modules, use.names = FALSE),
    module = rep(names(modules), lengths(modules)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  miss <- setdiff(map$gene, rownames(obj[[assay]]))
  if (length(miss)) message("Not in assay, dropped: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  map <- map[map$gene %in% rownames(obj[[assay]]), ]

  o <- obj
  if (scale_within_panel) {
    keep <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[group_by]] %in% pops_use]
    o <- subset(obj, cells = keep)
    o@meta.data[[group_by]] <- droplevels(factor(o@meta.data[[group_by]]))
  }

  d <- DotPlot(o, features = map$gene, group.by = group_by, assay = assay)$data
  d <- d[d$id %in% pops_use, ]
  d$gene <- as.character(d$features.plot)

  bad <- tapply(d$avg.exp.scaled, d$gene, function(x) all(!is.finite(x)))
  if (any(bad)) {
    message("Zero variance in this panel, dropped: ",
            paste(names(bad)[bad], collapse = ", "))
    d   <- d[!d$gene %in% names(bad)[bad], ]
    map <- map[!map$gene %in% names(bad)[bad], ]
  }

  d$module <- map$module[match(d$gene, map$gene)]
  d$gene   <- factor(d$gene,   levels = rev(map$gene))
  d$module <- factor(d$module, levels = names(modules))
  d$id     <- factor(as.character(d$id), levels = pops_use)
  d$expr   <- pmin(pmax(d$avg.exp.scaled, -cap), cap)
  d
}

panel_plot <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = id, y = gene, fill = expr)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(module), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey96", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-cap, cap), breaks = c(-cap, 0, cap),
      name   = "Scaled\nexpression",
      guide  = guide_colourbar(barwidth = 0.6, barheight = 6, ticks = FALSE)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0),
                     labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 16)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                                       margin = margin(b = 8)),
      panel.grid        = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.y   = unit(3, "pt"),
      strip.placement   = "outside",
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 9, colour = "grey25"),
      strip.background  = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x.top   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                                       size = 9, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y       = element_text(face = "italic", colour = "black", size = 9),
      axis.ticks        = element_blank(),
      legend.title      = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 14, 6, 6)
    )
}

d_cd4 <- panel_df(cd4_pops, modules_cd4)
d_cd8 <- panel_df(cd8_pops, modules_cd8)

p_cd4 <- panel_plot(d_cd4, "CD4 T cells and Treg")
p_cd8 <- panel_plot(d_cd8, "CD8 T cells, MAIT and \u03b3\u03b4 T")

print(p_cd4)
print(p_cd8)

private_markers <- function(d) {
  z <- acast(d, gene ~ id, value.var = "expr")
  vapply(colnames(z), function(cl) {
    own <- rownames(z)[colnames(z)[apply(z, 1, which.max)] == cl]
    if (!length(own)) NA_character_
    else sprintf("%s (%.2f)", own[which.max(z[own, cl])], max(z[own, cl]))
  }, character(1))
}

qc <- rbind(
  data.frame(panel = "CD4", population = cd4_pops,
             top_private_marker = private_markers(d_cd4)[cd4_pops]),
  data.frame(panel = "CD8", population = cd8_pops,
             top_private_marker = private_markers(d_cd8)[cd8_pops])
)
print(qc, row.names = FALSE)

min_pct  <- 0
use_viridis <- FALSE

panel_dotplot <- function(d, title) {

  d <- d[is.finite(d$expr), ]
  if (min_pct > 0) d <- d[d$pct.exp >= min_pct, ]

  fill_scale <- if (use_viridis) {
    scale_colour_viridis_c(
      option = "D", limits = c(-cap, cap), breaks = c(-cap, 0, cap),
      name  = "Scaled\nexpression",
      guide = guide_colourbar(barwidth = 0.6, barheight = 5, ticks = FALSE, order = 1)
    )
  } else {
    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey85", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-cap, cap), breaks = c(-cap, 0, cap),
      name  = "Scaled\nexpression",
      guide = guide_colourbar(barwidth = 0.6, barheight = 5, ticks = FALSE, order = 1)
    )
  }

  ggplot(d, aes(x = id, y = gene)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, colour = expr)) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(module), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    fill_scale +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(0.3, 6), limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
      name  = "% cells\nexpressing",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(colour = "grey30"))
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = expansion(add = 0.6),
                     labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 16)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                                       margin = margin(b = 8)),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "grey85", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.spacing.y   = unit(2, "pt"),
      strip.placement   = "outside",
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 9, colour = "grey25"),
      strip.background  = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x.top   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                                       size = 9, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y       = element_text(face = "italic", colour = "black", size = 9),
      axis.ticks        = element_blank(),
      legend.title      = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key        = element_blank(),
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 14, 6, 6)
    )
}

dp_cd4 <- panel_dotplot(d_cd4, "CD4 T cells and Treg")
dp_cd8 <- panel_dotplot(d_cd8, "CD8 T cells, MAIT and \u03b3\u03b4 T")

print(dp_cd4)
print(dp_cd8)

ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_tcells, "dotplot_CD4.png"), dp_cd4, width = 6.2,
        height = 1.8 + 0.28 * nlevels(droplevels(d_cd4$gene)))
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_tcells, "dotplot_CD8.png"), dp_cd8, width = 6.2,
        height = 1.8 + 0.28 * nlevels(droplevels(d_cd8$gene)))
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_tcells, "heatmap_CD4.png"), p_cd4, width = 6.2,
       height = 1.8 + 0.28 * nlevels(droplevels(d_cd4$gene)))
ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_tcells, "heatmap_CD8.png"), p_cd8, width = 6.2,
```

## 4.9 Composition

### 4.9.1 Differential abundance (edgeR, NB with log total offset)

```{r ab-fit, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
par_ab <- list(
  label_col       = "celltype",
  donor_col       = "patient_ID",
  group_col       = "diagnosis",
  compartment_col = "compartment",
  strat_col       = "severity_active",
  ref_group       = "control",
  min_cells       = 5,
  min_samples     = 0.5,
  fdr             = 0.05,
  ext_totals      = NULL)
meta_all <- ab_get_meta(lapply(t_cells_filtered, add_severity, quiet = TRUE), par_ab$compartment_col)

ab_t <- list()
for (ti in c("CSF", "PBMC")) {
  ab <- build_abundance_inputs(
    meta_all, compartment_col = par_ab$compartment_col, focus = ti,
    donor_col = par_ab$donor_col, group_col = par_ab$group_col,
    label_col = par_ab$label_col, strat_col = par_ab$strat_col,
    ref_group = par_ab$ref_group, min_cells = par_ab$min_cells,
    min_samples = par_ab$min_samples, ext_totals = par_ab$ext_totals)
  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ab$sinfo)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
  res <- fit_ab(ab$mat, ab$sinfo, ab$totals, design,
                coef = setdiff(colnames(design), "X.Intercept.")[1], fdr = par_ab$fdr)
  print(knitr::kable(cbind(ab$mat, total = ab$totals), caption = paste("Cell counts per donor -", ti)))
  print(knitr::kable(res %>% arrange(FDR) %>% select(celltype, logFC, ci_lo, ci_hi, PValue, FDR),
                     digits = 3, caption = paste("X-ALD vs control,", ti, "- log2 FC in proportion")))
  comp <- ab_compositional(ab, res) %>% dplyr::mutate(tissue = ti, .before = 1)
  fig  <- ab_res_for_figure(res, comp)
  print(plot_ab_figure(
    ab$long, fig$res, ab$totals, pal = umap_palette_for(fig_t_umap, ti, ab$long$celltype),
    title_a = "Per-donor composition", title_b_prefix = paste0("X-ALD vs control, ", fig$method),
    y_lab = paste("proportion of", ti, "T cells"), fdr = par_ab$fdr, x_lab = fig$x_lab, ci_label = fig$ci_label,
    out_file = file.path(path$graphs_tcells, paste0("t_cell_per_donor_", fig$method, "_", ti, ".jpg"))))
  ab_t[[ti]] <- list(inputs = ab, res = res, comp = comp, res_fig = fig$res, method = fig$method, x_lab = fig$x_lab)
}

store_figure_panels("tcells", "abundance", abundance_figure_panels(
  ab_t, umap_fig = fig_t_umap, ref_group = par_ab$ref_group,
  contrast = "X-ALD vs control", fdr = par_ab$fdr, y_lab = "proportion of T cells"))
```

## 4.10 Pseudobulk DEG (DESeq2)

```{r deg-constants}
CELLTYPE_COL     <- "celltype"
MIN_CELLS_SAMPLE <- DEG_MIN_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE
if (!exists("MIN_CELLS_SUBSET")) MIN_CELLS_SUBSET <- DEG_MIN_CELLS
if (!exists("SIG_COL"))          SIG_COL          <- "padj"
if (!exists("PADJ_T"))           PADJ_T           <- DEG_PADJ_THRESH
if (!exists("LFC_T"))            LFC_T            <- DEG_LFC_THRESH
if (!exists("MASK_CLASSES"))     MASK_CLASSES     <- DEG_MASK_CLASSES
```

### 4.10.1 Metadata: severity and CD4/CD8 lineage

```{r deg-meta}
if (!exists("t_cells_filtered"))
  t_cells_filtered <- qs::qread(tcells_output)

t_cells_DEG <- lapply(t_cells_filtered, function(so) {
  so <- add_severity(so)
  so$sev_grp <- sev_group3(so$severity)
  stopifnot(CELLTYPE_COL %in% colnames(so@meta.data))
  ct <- as.character(so@meta.data[[CELLTYPE_COL]])
  both <- grepl("CD4", ct, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("CD8", ct, ignore.case = TRUE)
  so$lineage <- dplyr::case_when(
    both | grepl("\\bDN\\b|double.neg", ct, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ NA_character_,
    grepl("Treg|CD4", ct, ignore.case = TRUE)                       ~ "CD4",
    grepl("CD8", ct, ignore.case = TRUE)                            ~ "CD8",
    TRUE                                                            ~ NA_character_)
  if (all(is.na(so$lineage)))
    stop("No CD4/CD8 labels matched in '", CELLTYPE_COL, "'. Labels present: ", paste(unique(ct), collapse = ", "))
  so
})
lapply(t_cells_DEG, function(so) table(so@meta.data[[CELLTYPE_COL]], so$lineage, useNA = "ifany"))

donors_in_fit <- function(meta, by) colSums(table(meta$patient_ID, interaction(meta[by], drop = TRUE)) >= MIN_CELLS_SAMPLE)
severity_report(t_cells_DEG, "tcells")
lapply(t_cells_DEG, function(so) donors_in_fit(so@meta.data, "sev_grp"))
lapply(t_cells_DEG, function(so) donors_in_fit(so@meta.data[!is.na(so$lineage), ], c("lineage", "sev_grp")))
```

### 4.10.2 Fits

```{r deg-run}
deg_label_of <- function(x) {
  lab <- unlist(c(deg_contrast_labels, if (exists("DEG_SEVERITY_LABELS")) DEG_SEVERITY_LABELS))
  out <- unname(lab[x]); out[is.na(out)] <- x[is.na(out)]
  stats::setNames(as.list(out), x)
}
tissues <- names(t_cells_DEG)
gs_units_t <- deg_loo_units(t_cells_DEG, tissues, "all_T", CELLTYPE_COL, lineage_col = "lineage",
                            min_cells = MIN_CELLS_SUBSET)
deg_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(gs_units_t, function(u) {
  message(u$tissue, " / ", u$level, " / ", u$subset)
  flatten_contrasts(run_all_contrasts(u$get()), u$tissue, u$level, u$subset)
}))
```

### 4.10.3 Collect

```{r deg-collect}
deg_all <- collect_deg_results(deg_all, csv_prefix = file.path(path$tables, "DEG_tcells"))
contrast_labels <- deg_label_of(sort(unique(deg_all$comparison)))

deg_all %>%
  group_by(tissue, level, subset, comparison) %>%
  summarise(ok = dplyr::first(status) == "ok", .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::count(comparison, ok)

sig <- deg_all %>% filter(status == "ok", deg_is_sig(.data[[SIG_COL]], log2FC, PADJ_T, LFC_T))
sig_main <- sig %>% filter(!gene_class %in% MASK_CLASSES)
```

#### Contrast inventory

```{r}
inventory <- deg_all %>%
  filter(status == "ok") %>%
  group_by(tissue, level, subset, comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    genes_tested  = n(),
    sig           = sum(deg_is_sig(padj, log2FC, PADJ_T, LFC_T), na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_main      = sum(deg_is_sig(padj, log2FC, PADJ_T, LFC_T) &
                        !gene_class %in% MASK_CLASSES, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig_highlight = sum(deg_is_highlight(padj, log2FC, PADJ_T, LFC_T, svalue = svalue) &
                        !gene_class %in% MASK_CLASSES, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_1k_tested = round(1000 * sig / genes_tested, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(sig))

inventory
```

#### Common gene universe

```{r}
common_universe <- deg_all %>%
  filter(status == "ok", level == "celltype") %>%
  group_by(tissue, comparison) %>%
  group_modify(function(df, key) {
    n_sub <- n_distinct(df$subset)
    keep  <- df %>% count(gene) %>% filter(n == n_sub) %>% pull(gene)
    df %>%
      filter(gene %in% keep, !gene_class %in% MASK_CLASSES) %>%
      group_by(subset) %>%
      summarise(universe = length(keep),
                up   = sum(deg_is_sig(padj, log2FC, PADJ_T, LFC_T) & log2FC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                down = sum(deg_is_sig(padj, log2FC, PADJ_T, LFC_T) & log2FC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop")
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

common_universe
```

#### Recurrence across cell types

```{r}
recurrence <- sig_main %>%
  filter(level == "celltype") %>%
  group_by(tissue, comparison, gene) %>%
  summarise(n_celltypes   = n_distinct(subset),
            celltypes     = paste(sort(unique(subset)), collapse = ", "),
            direction     = paste(sort(unique(ifelse(log2FC > 0, "up", "down"))), collapse = "/"),
            median_log2FC = round(median(log2FC), 2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_celltypes >= 2) %>%
  arrange(tissue, comparison, desc(n_celltypes))

head(recurrence, 20)
```

### 4.11.2 Gene-set tests

```{r tcell-gs-run}
gs_universe_t <- unique(deg_all$gene[deg_all$status == "ok"])
gs_t <- gs_assemble(gs_universe_t)
kable_save(gs_t$provenance %>% dplyr::arrange(panel, set), "geneset_provenance_tcells",
           caption = "T cells: gene sets, size, genes among the tested genes")

gs_res_t_all <- gs_run(deg_all, gs_t$sets, GS_CONTRASTS_T, levels_use = GS_LEVELS_T)
readr::write_csv(gs_res_t_all, file.path(path$tables, "geneset_tcells_all_rankings.csv"))

gs_reg_t <- gs_registry_from_units(gs_units_t)
gs_voom_t <- gs_run_voom(gs_reg_t, gs_t$sets)
gs_reg_t_sev <- gs_registry_severity(gs_units_t, setdiff(GS_CONTRASTS_T, "xALD_vs_ctrl"))
gs_voom_t_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(gs_voom_t, gs_run_voom(gs_reg_t_sev, gs_t$sets))
invisible(gc())

gs_res_t <- gs_finalise(gs_res_t_all, gs_t$provenance, gs_voom_t_all)
gs_res_t$shift_robust <- suppressWarnings(gs_shift_robust(gs_res_t))
readr::write_csv(gs_res_t, file.path(path$tables, "geneset_tcells.csv"))

shift_t <- gs_shift_diagnostics(deg_all, GS_CONTRASTS_T, GS_LEVELS_T, gs_res_t_all)
kable_save(shift_t, "geneset_tcells_shift_diagnostics", digits = 3,
           caption = "T cells: global-shift diagnostics per family, gene and set level, with verdict")
print(knitr::kable(dplyr::count(shift_t, comparison, verdict)))

gs_res_t %>%
  dplyr::filter(agree, panel != "control") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(comparison, tissue, level, subset, padj_camera_vc_est, padj_fgsea) %>%
  dplyr::select(comparison, tissue, level, subset, set, inference, tier, NES, dplyr::any_of(c(
    "mean_logFC", "corr_camera_vc_est", "padj_camera_vc_est", "padj_fry", "fry_sig", "padj_camera_vc")),
    padj_fgsea, padj_camera, padj_camera_sens, padj_matched,
    dplyr::any_of(c("robust_matched", "robust_intensity", "NES_median_centred", "NES_intensity_resid")),
    global_shift_flag, ieg_flag, leading_edge) %>%
  kable_save("geneset_tcells_significant", digits = 3,
             caption = "T cells: significant sets (donor-level call where available, else gene-level screen); robustness columns")

gs_res_t %>% dplyr::filter(agree, panel != "control") %>%
  dplyr::count(comparison, inference, global_shift_flag, dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of("robust_intensity"))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Significant sets and the shift checks")
```

```{r tcell-gs-donor, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 6}
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = SEV_GROUP3_LABELS) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(set ~ celltype) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Per-donor set score (mean z)", shape = "Hydrocortisone",
                title = "CSF T cells: per-donor set scores") +
  gs_theme() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                 strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))
print(p_donor_t)
save_umap_fig(p_donor_t, "geneset_tcells_donor_scores_CSF", path$graphs_tcells,
              width_mm = FIG_WIDTH_MM[["double"]], height_mm = min(FIG_MAX_DEPTH_MM, 28 * length(GS_DONOR_SHOW_T) + 30))

donor_assoc_t <- gs_donor_associations(gs_donor_t)
readr::write_csv(donor_assoc_t, file.path(path$tables, "geneset_tcells_donor_associations.csv"))
```

## 4.12 Leave-one-donor-out: DEG and gene sets

```{r tcell-loo, cache = FALSE, error = FALSE}
units_t <- if (exists("gs_units_t")) Filter(function(u) u$tissue %in% DEG_LOO_TISSUES, gs_units_t) else
  deg_loo_units(t_cells_DEG, DEG_LOO_TISSUES, "all_T", CELLTYPE_COL, lineage_col = "lineage")
loo_t   <- deg_loo_run(units_t, deg_all, "tcells")
loo_gs_t <- gs_loo_voom(c(gs_reg_t, gs_reg_t_sev), gs_t$sets, gs_res_t)

fam_t <- loo_t$families
if (!is.null(fam_t)) {
  if (!any(fam_t$status == "ok")) stop("LOO: no family could be fit")
  stale <- dplyr::filter(fam_t, sig_match %in% FALSE)
  if (nrow(stale))
    stop("deg_all is stale for ", nrow(stale), " families: ",
         paste(stale$tissue, stale$level, stale$subset, stale$comparison, sep = "/", collapse = "; "),
         " -- rerun DEG before LOO")
  readr::write_csv(fam_t, file.path(path$tables, "DEG_tcells_loo_families.csv"))
}
readr::write_csv(loo_t$genes, file.path(path$tables, "DEG_tcells_loo_genes.csv"))
readr::write_csv(loo_t$folds, file.path(path$tables, "DEG_tcells_loo_folds.csv"))

loo_sum_t <- deg_loo_summary(loo_t$genes)
kable_save(loo_sum_t, "DEG_tcells_loo_summary", digits = 3,
           caption = "T-cell DEG: share of significant genes that stay significant when one donor is removed")
deg_all <- collect_deg_results(loo_annotate(deg_all, loo_t$genes, "gene"),
                               csv_prefix = file.path(path$tables, "DEG_tcells"))

gs_res_t <- loo_annotate(gs_res_t, loo_gs_t, "set")
readr::write_csv(gs_res_t, file.path(path$tables, "geneset_tcells.csv"))
kable_save(deg_loo_summary(loo_gs_t), "geneset_tcells_loo_summary", digits = 3,
           caption = "T-cell gene sets: share of significant sets retained when one donor is removed")
gs_res_t %>%
  dplyr::filter(agree, panel != "control") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(comparison, tissue, level, subset, padj_camera_vc_est) %>%
  dplyr::select(comparison, tissue, level, subset, set, inference, tier, NES, padj_camera_vc_est, padj_fry,
                global_shift_flag, ieg_flag, loo_frac_retained, loo_status, loo_lost_without, leading_edge) %>%
  kable_save("geneset_tcells_significant", digits = 3,
             caption = "T cells: significant sets with leave-one-donor-out")
knitr::kable(loo_sum_t, caption = "T-cell DEG leave-one-donor-out (CSF and PBMC)")
```

```{r tcell-vs-myeloid-gs}
if (!exists("gs_res_mc")) {

  cmp_t_mc <- dplyr::full_join(pick(gs_res_mc, "all_myeloid", "myeloid"),

    "Same gene sets in all T cells vs all myeloid cells (NES, fgsea padj, agree)."))
} else message("myeloid gene-set results not found -- run Part 3 first")
```

# Supplement

## S4.1 Detection-rate adjustment

```{r tcell-gs-cdr}
if (isTRUE(GS_ADJUST_CDR)) {
  gs_reg_t_adj <- gs_registry_adjust(gs_reg_t)
  gs_voom_t_adj <- gs_run_voom(gs_reg_t_adj, gs_t$sets)

  kable_save(gs_corr_summary(gs_voom_t, gs_voom_t_adj), "geneset_tcells_cdr_correlation", digits = 3,
             caption = "T cells, X-ALD vs control: camera's estimated within-set correlation and significant sets, without / with detection-rate covariate")

  deg_t_reg <- gs_registry_deg(gs_reg_t)
  deg_t_adj <- gs_registry_deg(gs_reg_t_adj)
  conc_t <- gs_deg_concordance(deg_t_reg, deg_t_adj)
  readr::write_csv(conc_t, file.path(path$tables, "DEG_tcells_cdr_concordance.csv"))
  kable_save(conc_t %>% dplyr::arrange(tissue, level, subset), "DEG_tcells_cdr_concordance", digits = 3,
             caption = "T cells, X-ALD vs control: DEGs without vs with detection-rate covariate (supplement)")

  gs_res_t_adj_all <- gs_run(deg_t_adj, gs_t$sets, "xALD_vs_ctrl", levels_use = GS_LEVELS_T)
  gs_res_t_adj <- gs_finalise(gs_res_t_adj_all, gs_t$provenance, gs_voom_t_adj)
  readr::write_csv(gs_res_t_adj, file.path(path$tables, "geneset_tcells_cdr_adjusted.csv"))

  cmp_t <- dplyr::full_join(
    gs_res_t %>% dplyr::filter(comparison == "xALD_vs_ctrl", panel != "control") %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(GS_KEYS), set, NES, padj_camera_vc_est, padj_fry, agree),
    gs_res_t_adj %>% dplyr::filter(panel != "control") %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(GS_KEYS), set, NES, padj_camera_vc_est, padj_fry, agree,
                    dplyr::any_of(c("robust_matched", "robust_intensity")), leading_edge),
    by = c(GS_KEYS, "set"), suffix = c("_unadj", "_adj")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(agree_unadj %in% TRUE | agree_adj %in% TRUE)
  readr::write_csv(cmp_t, file.path(path$tables, "geneset_tcells_cdr_comparison.csv"))
  print(knitr::kable(dplyr::count(cmp_t, tissue, unadjusted = agree_unadj %in% TRUE, adjusted = agree_adj %in% TRUE),
                     caption = "Significant sets without / with the detection-rate covariate"))
  cmp_t %>% dplyr::filter(agree_adj %in% TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(tissue, level, subset, padj_camera_vc_est_adj) %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, level, subset, set, NES_adj, padj_camera_vc_est_adj, padj_fry_adj,
                  dplyr::any_of(c("robust_matched", "robust_intensity")), agree_unadj, leading_edge) %>%
    kable_save("geneset_tcells_cdr_significant", digits = 3,
               caption = "T cells, X-ALD vs control: significant sets with the detection-rate covariate")
}
```

## S4.2 Calibration

```{r tcell-gs-calibration}
GS_CALIBRATE_T   <- TRUE
GS_CALIB_N_MAX   <- 200
GS_CALIB_FAMS_T  <- list(c("CSF", "all_T", "all"), c("PBMC", "all_T", "all"))
calib_file <- file.path(path$objects, "gs_calibration_tcells.qs")
if (isTRUE(GS_CALIBRATE_T)) {
  calib_t <- if (file.exists(calib_file)) qs::qread(calib_file) else {
    pick <- function(reg, f) Filter(function(e) e$tissue == f[1] && e$level == f[2] && e$subset == f[3], reg)
    regs <- list(gs_reg_t, if (exists("gs_reg_t_adj")) gs_reg_t_adj)
    out <- list()
    for (f in GS_CALIB_FAMS_T) for (r in Filter(Negate(is.null), regs)) for (e in pick(r, f)) {
      message("calibration: ", paste(f, collapse = " | "), " | ", if (is.null(e$adjusted)) "unadjusted" else "adjusted")
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- gs_calibrate_voom(e, gs_t$sets, n_max = GS_CALIB_N_MAX)
    }
    out <- Filter(Negate(is.null), out)
    qs::qsave(out, calib_file)
    out
  }
  calib_sum_t <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(calib_t, `[[`, "summary"))
  kable_save(calib_sum_t, "geneset_tcells_calibration", digits = 3,
             caption = "T cells: share of p < 0.05 under relabelled donors (non-control sets); calibrated test ~0.05, 'balanced' = relabelings mixing the true groups evenly")
}
```
